apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: transmission
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: transmission
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: transmission
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: transmission
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: transmission
        image: ghcr.io/k8s-at-home/transmission:v3.00
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 50Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
        ports:
        - name: gui-port
          protocol: TCP
          containerPort: 9091
        - name: tcp-port
          protocol: TCP
          containerPort: 51413
        - name: udp-port
          protocol: UDP
          containerPort: 51413
        volumeMounts:
        - name: transmission-configs
          mountPath: /config/settings.json
          subPath: settings.json
        - name: transmission-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: transmission-downloads
          mountPath: /downloads
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: tcp-port
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          successThreshold: 1
          failureThreshold: 5
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: tcp-port
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          successThreshold: 1
          failureThreshold: 5
        env:
        - name: TZ
          value: ${CONFIG_TIMEZONE}
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
      volumes:
      - name: transmission-configs
        configMap:
          name: transmission-configs
      - name: transmission-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: transmission-config
      - name: transmission-downloads
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: shared-downloads

kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-master
  namespace: default
  labels:
    name: redis-master
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-master
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-master
        redis-master: 'true'
      annotations:
        security.alpha.kubernetes.io/sysctls: net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=0,net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=10000
          65535
        security.alpha.kubernetes.io/unsafe-sysctls: net.core.somaxconn=65535,net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1,net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30,net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl=4,net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes=3,net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=120,net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=65535,net.ipv4.tcp_rfc1337=1,net.ipv4.tcp_slow_start_after_idle=0,net.ipv4.tcp_fack=1,net.ipv4.tcp_fwmark_accept=1,net.ipv4.fwmark_reflect=1
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis
        image: slpcat/redis-3.2:stable
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        env:
        - name: MASTER
          value: 'true'
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 250m
          limits:
            memory: 2Gi
            cpu: 2000m
        volumeMounts:
        - name: redis-master-volume
          mountPath: /var/lib/redis
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          privileged: false
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
      - name: redis-master-volume
        emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    kustomize.component: iap-ingress
  name: iap-enabler
  namespace: kubeflow
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      kustomize.component: iap-ingress
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        kustomize.component: iap-ingress
        service: iap-enabler
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - bash
        - /var/envoy-config/setup_backend.sh
        env:
        - name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
          value: /var/run/secrets/sa/admin-gcp-sa.json
        - name: NAMESPACE
          value: istio-system
        - name: SERVICE
          value: istio-ingressgateway
        - name: INGRESS_NAME
          value: envoy-ingress
        - name: ENVOY_ADMIN
          value: http://localhost:8001
        - name: USE_ISTIO
          value: 'true'
        image: gcr.io/kubeflow-images-public/ingress-setup:stable
        name: iap
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/sa
          name: sa-key
          readOnly: true
        - mountPath: /var/envoy-config/
          name: config-volume
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          privileged: false
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      serviceAccountName: kf-admin
      volumes:
      - name: sa-key
        secret:
          secretName: admin-gcp-sa
      - configMap:
          name: envoy-config
        name: config-volume

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    kustomize.component: iap-ingress
  name: iap-enabler
  namespace: kubeflow
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      kustomize.component: iap-ingress
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        kustomize.component: iap-ingress
        service: iap-enabler
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - bash
        - /var/envoy-config/setup_backend.sh
        env:
        - name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
          value: /var/run/secrets/sa/admin-gcp-sa.json
        - name: NAMESPACE
          value: istio-system
        - name: SERVICE
          value: istio-ingressgateway
        - name: INGRESS_NAME
          value: envoy-ingress
        - name: ENVOY_ADMIN
          value: http://localhost:8001
        - name: USE_ISTIO
          value: 'true'
        image: gcr.io/kubeflow-images-public/ingress-setup:stable
        name: iap
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/sa
          name: sa-key
          readOnly: true
        - mountPath: /var/envoy-config/
          name: config-volume
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      serviceAccountName: kf-admin
      volumes:
      - name: sa-key
        secret:
          secretName: admin-gcp-sa
      - configMap:
          name: envoy-config
        name: config-volume
